name: ai-calling-agent
description: Outbound AI calling agent for event organizers

scripts.dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js --kill-others --names server,web "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.start: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js --kill-others --names server,web "npm start --workspace apps/server" "npm start --workspace apps/web"
